coverage_rules.current_user_text: Every original goal and handled MESSAGE/CORRECTION is read from its event-bound CAS object, included verbatim, and bound by content/text hashes plus the current task/input/control frontier.
coverage_rules.summary_claim: No semantic requirement compression is implemented or claimed in G1.
coverage_rules.overflow: Projection sizing is checked after each required body; once overflow is proven, later requirement bodies are not decrypted and all affected source handles are returned for CONTEXT_BLOCKED.
coverage_rules.blocker_evidence: Index resolution and content verification are distinct. Current blocker evidence is VERIFIED, STALE, MISSING_REFERENCE, or NOT_REQUIRED; stale/missing evidence makes the projection not ready for a request.
coverage_rules.eliminated_methods: No failure is inferred to be an eliminated method. The field remains NOT_CLASSIFIED until an explicit later semantic rule is connected.
